paragraphs: R. Yishmael ben Ḥananyah, Rabban Yoḥanan ben Zakkai's student. He called him 'גרוע in the wilderness' [difficult source reading] (in שס״ח [provisionally the new Shas]: a garden bed; in Massekhet Derekh Eretz: a deep garden bed), which holds its water. Avot deRabbi Natan, chapter 14 (see Rabban Yoḥanan ben Zakkai).
